#402 [architecture] flow/add-reading-time/spec

# Spec: add-reading-time

## Requirements

### REQ-001: wordCount (MUST)
`wordCount(str)` returns the number of words in `str`. Words are separated by runs of whitespace; leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.

Scenario 1: Counts words
  Given the text "the quick  brown\tfox"
  When wordCount runs
  Then it returns 4

Scenario 2: Empty text
  Given the text "   "
  When wordCount runs
  Then it returns 0

### REQ-002: readingTime (MUST)
`readingTime(str, { wordsPerMinute = 200 } = {})` returns the whole number of minutes needed to read `str`: `Math.ceil(wordCount(str) / wordsPerMinute)`.

Scenario 1: Rounds up
  Given a text of 201 words
  When readingTime runs with the default speed
  Then it returns 2

Scenario 2: Custom speed
  Given a text of 300 words
  When readingTime runs with wordsPerMinute 100
  Then it returns 3

Scenario 3: Empty text
  Given the text ""
  When readingTime runs
  Then it returns 0

Topic: flow/add-reading-time/spec
Project: textkit

#403 [architecture] flow/add-reading-time/design

# Design: add-reading-time

## Decisions
- D1: `wordCount` lives in `src/word-count.js`: `String(str).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length`.
- D2: `readingTime` lives in `src/reading-time.js` and reuses `wordCount`; the speed defaults to 200 words per minute.
- D3: Both are re-exported from `src/index.js`. No dependencies are added.

## File Changes
- Create `src/word-count.js`, `test/word-count.test.js`.
- Create `src/reading-time.js`, `test/reading-time.test.js`.
- Modify `src/index.js` (two new exports).

## Testing Strategy
vitest unit tests per function, written first (TDD), covering every spec scenario. Run with `npm test`.
